parsed.explanation: Rating reflects documented current birth-sex enforcement rather than criminalisation. No trans-specific criminal offence and residual gender-reassignment protections, plus courts and city-level queer presence, provide a floor. But the top-court/statutory code, police strip/stop-search policies, prison-guidance litigation, hospital-ward plans and non-recognition of foreign certificates impose universal, traveller-facing facility, security and care exposures if discovered. These can cause humiliation, exclusion, misgendered custody and care delays; media hostility increases social risk. Visitor-specific border/prison facts are unresolved, and legal challenge pending, but no clearly working protective remedy offsets institutionalised exclusion.
